annotations.title: How many jobs has AI replaced?

description: Answers 'how many jobs has AI replaced (or cost) this year?' with the register's published count: roles disclosed in layoffs linked to AI, roles where the employer itself named AI, the evidence-weighted headline figure, and the independent Challenger, Gray & Christmas count of US cuts attributed to AI. Each figure carries its scope (worldwide or US), its period and its definition, plus the ready-made answer sentence. The totals are computed over the whole register, so they are the published figures, not a sum of search results. Takes no arguments.
name: count_ai_job_losses
